A_general.open_code_note: No official public Salesloft MCP repository or package was found in the prepared evidence. The hosted endpoint is OAuth-protected; the available public materials do not expose implementation code.
other_official_servers: https://mcp.salesloft.com/sse — listed by Salesloft in Claude’s connector directory. The directory exposes a 14-tool listing including conversation_transcript_by_id; this differs from third-party listings associated with the input /mcp endpoint.

B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: No separate MCP price was found on the official pricing page. A third-party directory, citing Salesloft Help Center material, reports that access requires a Salesloft Agent package such as Account Agent or Coaching Agent and is included with that package.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: NOT FOUND; the official pricing page did not provide a specific amount in the collected text.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: Official pricing page describes Salesloft products and MCP but supplies no amount in the collected page text. Third-party report says MCP is included with certain Agent packages; pricing for those packages was not confirmed.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: The endpoint requires OAuth. A third-party directory reports that an organization admin must enable the MCP Server and that access follows the user's existing Salesloft permissions. The OAuth metadata advertises accounts:read, ai_feedback:write, conversations:read, opportunities:read, people:read, and team:read.
B_access_pricing.restrictions_controlled_by: Vendor and organization admin; user access is reportedly inherited from Salesloft permissions.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: The input /mcp endpoint returned HTTP 401 with “User not authenticated”; therefore its live tool manifest could not be retrieved. APIs.io lists 15 tools for the /mcp endpoint, including two feedback-related tools. This is third-party evidence, not a directly observed manifest.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: Unknown. The unauthenticated endpoint returned JSON-RPC error code -32000 with message “User not authenticated”, id null, and jsonrpc 2.0.
C_capabilities.authorization_mechanism: Metadata Doc: protected-resource metadata advertises bearer token in header and authorization server https://accounts.salesloft.com/mcp. The authorization server advertises Dynamic Client Registration at https://accounts.salesloft.com/oauth/client/register; authorization_code and refresh_token grants; S256 PKCE; token endpoint auth methods client_secret_basic and client_secret_post; revocation at https://accounts.salesloft.com/oauth/revoke. scopes_supported: accounts:read, ai_feedback:write, conversations:read, opportunities:read, people:read, team:read. Token lifetime: NOT FOUND.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. Third-party evidence describes the /mcp tool set as read-oriented, but the catalogued submit_feedback tool is a write operation; no tool annotations were obtained. 2. No server-enforced confirmation, preview, elicitation, or approval flow was verified. 3. OAuth scopes are accounts:read, ai_feedback:write, conversations:read, opportunities:read, people:read, team:read. Third-party sources report inherited Salesloft permissions and an admin enable switch; token lifetime and client allowlists are unknown. 4. Input /mcp and separately listed /sse paths exist; no read-only mode, URL tool filters, or sandbox endpoint was found. 5. Role-scoped permissions are claimed in Claude's listing; no field masking or PII filtering logic was documented. 6. Rate limits and truncation were not confirmed in official material. 7. Input validation, coercion, and parameter overrides are unknown. 8. MCP-specific logging, audit trail, and telemetry are unknown. 9. APIs.io lists submit_feedback and report_missing_functionality; these may send feedback or product-gap reports. 10. No server-delivered skill or initialize instruction was found; catalogue descriptions may steer feedback use, but enforcement is unknown. 11. Memory/state behavior is unknown. 12. The vendor also lists /sse; no sub-server hierarchy was verified. 13. No raw API, arbitrary SQL, shell, or script tool appeared in the /mcp catalogue list.

D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: Salesloft has a separately listed /sse endpoint in Claude’s connector directory, while the study input is /mcp. Catalogue reports associate a different 15-tool listing with /mcp. Their relationship and whether tool availability differs are not verified.

E_aggregated.action_count_comment: No accessible vendor-published tool reference or public code was found. APIs.io lists 15 tool names for the input https://mcp.salesloft.com/mcp endpoint; all 15 are included in actions.json and labeled third-party because the names were confirmed in a catalogue, not a directly accessible official list. APIs.io’s server page names 15 tools; its associated endpoint page says 15 read-only tools but the enumerated list includes report_missing_functionality and submit_feedback. Claude’s connector directory lists 14 tools for https://mcp.salesloft.com/sse, including conversation_transcript_by_id instead of the two feedback tools listed for /mcp. Agentman also reports 14 tools for the Claude listing; MartechDB reports 13 tools for /mcp; StackMCP describes categories but does not enumerate the full list. Counts differ by source and endpoint.

E_aggregated.token_method: No public implementation code or verbatim complete tool definitions and initialize instructions for the input endpoint were available. The endpoint returned 401 without authentication.
E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: Salesloft product functions beyond the listed read/query and feedback tools are not established as accessible via this MCP endpoint. The vendor’s announcements describe roadmap/expansion areas including cadence and activity data, Clari call intelligence, forecast and deal inspection, and write-back; they do not document exact MCP tool operations for this input endpoint. Do not infer those functions are agent-accessible from the announcements alone.

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: The Claude directory describes the connector as providing “role-scoped permissions so you only see your own data.” No tool descriptions or initialize instructions were retrieved to establish further agent-facing rules. APIs.io’s catalogue describes submit_feedback as recording explicit user feedback; server enforcement and conditions were not verified.
F_documentation.governance_promises: The Claude directory claims “Secured with OAuth 2.0 and role-scoped permissions so you only see your own data.” A third-party directory attributes read-only access, inherited permissions, and no model training to Salesloft Help Center material; the Help Center copies available for this review returned only a loading shell, so those claims are not independently verified here. Salesloft’s privacy policy says it does not cover Customer Data processed on behalf of customers.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: Salesloft’s newsroom states the MCP expansion is intended to make revenue intelligence available to AI tools through a governed connection. Its July 2026 announcement describes planned/rolling additions including cadence and activity data, conversation intelligence, connectors, and write-back.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: OAuth protection and the published scope list are evidenced by endpoint metadata. The endpoint’s role/record enforcement, read-only behavior, data retention, model-training restrictions, and any write-back are not verifiable from the unauthenticated endpoint. The announced write-back capability and the catalogue’s read-only characterization do not establish which tools are available at this input endpoint.

contradictions: OAuth metadata advertises ai_feedback:write, while some third-party descriptions characterize all MCP scopes as read-only and the endpoint’s associated APIs.io entry calls the server read-only. APIs.io separately lists submit_feedback as a tool that records feedback.

The input endpoint is /mcp, whose APIs.io listing names report_missing_functionality and submit_feedback. Claude’s directory lists /sse and names conversation_transcript_by_id instead; the two endpoint listings therefore disagree in tool names and scope.

Third-party sources report different counts: APIs.io lists 15 names for /mcp; Claude and Agentman list 14 for /sse; MartechDB reports 13 for /mcp. Tool lists may reflect different dates, paths, or catalogue completeness.

Salesloft’s July 2026 newsroom announcement describes write-back and broader data coverage as part of an expansion, while third-party sources characterize the currently documented MCP server as read-only. The announcement does not identify the input endpoint’s exact tool set.
observations_for_research: The OAuth scopes disclose a feedback-writing capability even though several secondary descriptions characterize the connector as read-only.
The vendor has a separately listed /sse path alongside the study input /mcp path; tool inventories and counts differ between catalogue sources.
The public materials combine endpoint protection metadata with marketing announcements about broader rollout, but the input endpoint did not provide an unauthenticated tool manifest.
notes: Checked links.json, links_check.txt, all prepared pages including pageN.script.txt and pageN.html, the available code folder, official newsroom pages, official pricing/legal pages, the official Claude connector listing, and listed catalogues.
